endpoints.description: Returns API readiness plus dependency status (also mounted at /api/v1/health for client callers).

rest_exception.note: Plain GET /health for lifecycle systems, load balancers, and curl probes that cannot use a generated Connect client.

endpoints.description: Compares each enabled manifest route's expected local_port against the UI port declared in the scenario's service.json, returning one finding per route plus a count of violations (status != compliant).

properties.violation_count: int32 (count of results with status != compliant)

endpoints.description: Returns the persisted tunnel configuration (mode and Cloudflare coordinates) through the generated Connect-RPC Config service.

endpoints.summary: Reconcile ingress with the routes manifest
endpoints.description: Computes desired ingress from enabled routes (subdomain.domain hostnames → http://localhost:<port> + catch-all 404), diffs it against live ingress, and applies the difference (Cloudflare API in remote mode; config.yml + cloudflared restart in local mode). dry_run computes the diff without applying. Idempotent: a no-drift sync applies nothing.

errors.description: Remote mode requested but Cloudflare credentials are absent

endpoints.summary: Ensure an explicitly owned deployment DNS record
endpoints.description: Reconciles one A, AAAA, or CNAME record through the configured provider profile. The provider profile and owner are explicit; this operation never infers the local tunnel domain.

errors.description: DNS provider credentials or managed DNS configuration is unavailable
A record with different content or proxy mode already exists

endpoints.description: Returns browser-safe Cloudflare credential presence/source metadata. Secret values are never returned.
Performs read-only Cloudflare probes (token verify, account/tunnel read, apex zone lookup + DNS-records read) and returns a per-check verdict with remediation. Never returns secret values.

errors.description: Live credential verification is not configured

endpoints.description: Adopts or creates the named Cloudflare tunnel from one operator API token and writes the complete derived credential set only after the connector token is fetched.

errors.description: Operator token required when authz is enforced
Cloudflare API token lacks the required account permission

endpoints.description: Stores write-only Cloudflare credential values in the canonical operator credential authority and returns redacted status metadata.

errors.description: Operator token required when authz is enforced

endpoints.description: Removes Cloudflare credential values from the canonical operator credential authority.

errors.description: Operator token required when authz is enforced

endpoints.description: Migrates between remote (Cloudflare API) and local (config.yml) management, applies the current manifest's ingress through the target channel, and persists the new mode.

errors.description: Remote mode requested but Cloudflare credentials are absent

endpoints.description: Reconciles the desired manifest, the live tunnel, and the ownership ledger into a classified read model (managed/missing/external_ok/orphaned/ignored/unmanaged). Read-only — never applies.

properties.entries: array<IngressEntry> (hostname, service_target, state, source, scenario, lease_id, note)

errors.description: Remote mode requested but Cloudflare credentials are absent

endpoints.description: Brings an unmanaged live hostname under management: as a scenario route when it resolves to a known scenario, otherwise as an external route. Records MANAGED/EXTERNAL ownership in the ledger.

properties.target: string (adopt as external route pointing here)

errors.description: Operator token required when authz is enforced
A route already exists for the subdomain
Route create or ledger write failure

endpoints.description: Acknowledges a live hostname as external and records it IGNORED, so reconcile never pushes or prunes it.

errors.description: Operator token required when authz is enforced

endpoints.description: Removes a single named hostname from live ingress and the ownership ledger. The only path that removes a specific entry.

errors.description: Operator token required when authz is enforced
Remote mode requested but Cloudflare credentials are absent
Ingress apply or ledger delete failure

endpoints.description: Flips the global public-exposure capability (the /public-asset convention). PURE: persists the flag and performs zero Cloudflare writes — the next Sync reconciles the live Access apps.

errors.description: Operator token required when authz is enforced

endpoints.description: Returns the public-exposure read model: the global switch, whether the Access client is configured, per-host effective decisions, and the dry-run plan (apps a reconcile would create/remove). Read-only — no Cloudflare calls.

endpoints.summary: Resolve managed Cloudflare Access verifier metadata
endpoints.description: Returns the non-secret team domain, audience, and recovery URL for an enabled scenario route. Tunnel Manager resolves the route and primary Access application; no Cloudflare writes or credentials are involved.

errors.description: No unique enabled route for the scenario
Cloudflare credentials or Access metadata are unavailable
Route or Cloudflare metadata read failure

endpoints.description: Ensures the scenario has a LEASED route, is running, and has live ingress; returns the lease and reachable URL. Idempotent — re-exposing extends the existing lease rather than duplicating ingress.

errors.description: Scenario has no resolvable fixed UI port

endpoints.description: Pushes a lease's expiry out by ttl_seconds from now.
Ends a lease immediately and retracts ingress unless the scenario is also CORE.

properties.retracted: bool (false when scenario is also CORE)

endpoints.description: Revokes a scenario's active lease by name, retracting ingress and the TM-created DNS record unless the scenario is also CORE.

properties.retracted: bool (false when scenario is also CORE)

errors.description: No active lease for that scenario

endpoints.description: Returns leases newest-first, optionally filtered by status.
Returns the reconciled exposure state per scenario (tier, route, lease, reachability) — the data behind the Exposure UI surface.
Reports whether a scenario is currently reachable and, if so, its public URL — the read backing app-monitor open-in-new-tab.
Re-derives CORE routes from the coreset closure and reaps expired leases. Idempotent; also run on a timer.
Probes every enabled route's local port (internal) and public URL (external), persists the results, and returns them, through the generated Connect-RPC Probes service.
Returns recent probe history newest-first, optionally filtered by subdomain, through the generated Connect-RPC Probes service.
Derives the per-route reachability diagnosis (healthy / tunnel-down / scenario-down / config-drift) from the latest stored internal+external probes.
Returns the live recovery state-machine snapshot (status, consecutive failures, backoff level, circuit-breaker state) through the generated Connect-RPC Recovery service.
Returns the recovery event log newest-first, capped at limit (default 50), through the generated Connect-RPC Recovery service.
Triggers a manual cloudflared recovery attempt. Idempotent while a recovery is already in flight (returns SKIPPED); rejected while the circuit breaker is open unless force is true.
Returns all manifest routes ordered by subdomain, optionally filtered by tier, through the generated Connect-RPC Routes service.
Returns the manifest route matching the request id through the generated Connect-RPC Routes service.

errors.description: No route with that id exists

endpoints.description: Persists a new manifest route. Subdomain (valid DNS label), scenario, local_port, and domain are required; health_path defaults to /health, tier to leased, enabled to true.

errors.description: Invalid subdomain, missing scenario, or out-of-range port
A route already exists for the subdomain

endpoints.description: Applies a partial update to the route with the given id; only set fields change.

errors.description: No route with that id exists

endpoints.description: Removes a manifest route by id. Returns deleted=false when the id did not exist.
Returns the current composite tunnel health (cloudflared systemd unit state + /ready probe) plus the most recent scraped metrics sample, through the generated Connect-RPC Tunnel service.
Returns persisted Prometheus metrics samples scraped within the optional [from, to] window, ordered by scraped_at ascending, through the generated Connect-RPC Tunnel service.
Fetches the cloudflared /metrics endpoint once, parses the key gauges/counters, persists the sample, and returns it, through the generated Connect-RPC Tunnel service.
